northpoint: Make agent work observable, audible, recoverable and manageable from one installable Constellation application.
pillars: Preserve existing project, capture, desktop and continuity capabilities
Rust native coordination and persistence with required browser API bindings
Event-driven observation with explicit unavailable states and no idle polling loops
Durable incident deduplication and tested sound/notification channels
Direct human permission decisions; never auto-click consent
One native hub with a sensor in each monitored browser/profile; no false single-extension cross-browser claim
Preserve every Computer-Link capability, branch, commit, notice and optional diagnostic route
Install per user with repair, rollback, ownership-aware uninstall and native on-demand lifetime
Close out accepted upgrades with a versioned GitHub release and verified published bytes
